question: Parallel forces acting in the same direction are called:
urdu_translation: same direction میں acting parallel forces کو کیا کہتے ہیں؟
A: Like parallel forces / like parallel forces
B: Unlike parallel forces / unlike parallel forces
correct_answer: A | Like parallel forces / like parallel forces

question: Parallel forces acting in opposite directions are called:
urdu_translation: opposite directions میں acting parallel forces کو کیا کہتے ہیں؟
A: Like parallel forces / like parallel forces
B: Unlike parallel forces / unlike parallel forces
correct_answer: B | Unlike parallel forces / unlike parallel forces

question: A single force having the same effect as several forces is called:
urdu_translation: کئی forces کے same effect والی single force کو کیا کہتے ہیں؟
D: Centre of gravity / centre of gravity
correct_answer: B | Resultant force / resultant force

question: Two forces of 4 N and 3 N act simultaneously on a particle. The resultant magnitude must lie:
urdu_translation: 4 N اور 3 N forces simultaneously particle پر act کرتی ہیں۔ resultant magnitude کس range میں ہوگی؟
A: Between 1 N and 7 N / 1 N اور 7 N کے درمیان
correct_answer: A | Between 1 N and 7 N / 1 N اور 7 N کے درمیان

question: The component of force F along the x-axis is:
urdu_translation: force F کا x-axis کے along component کیا ہے؟
correct_answer: D | F cosθ

question: The component of force F along the y-axis is:
urdu_translation: force F کا y-axis کے along component کیا ہے؟
correct_answer: D | F sinθ

question: A 200 N force acts at 30° above the horizontal. Its vertical component is:
urdu_translation: 200 N force horizontal سے 30° above act کرتی ہے۔ vertical component معلوم کریں۔

question: A force F makes an angle of 60° with the x-axis. Its y-component is:
urdu_translation: force F، x-axis کے ساتھ 60° angle بناتی ہے۔ y-component کیا ہے؟
correct_answer: D | F sin60°

question: The line along which a force acts is called its:
urdu_translation: وہ line جس کے along force act کرتی ہے کیا کہلاتی ہے؟
B: Line of action / line of action
C: Axis of mass / axis of mass
correct_answer: B | Line of action / line of action

question: The perpendicular distance from the axis of rotation to the line of action is the:
urdu_translation: axis of rotation سے line of action تک perpendicular distance کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
B: Centre of mass / centre of mass
correct_answer: D | Moment arm / moment arm

question: The moment or torque of a force is calculated by:
urdu_translation: force کا moment یا torque کیسے calculate کیا جاتا ہے؟
correct_answer: A | τ = F × perpendicular distance

question: The SI unit of torque is:
urdu_translation: torque کی SI unit کیا ہے؟
correct_answer: A | N·m

question: A couple consists of:
urdu_translation: couple کن forces پر مشتمل ہوتا ہے؟
A: Two equal forces acting at the same point / same point پر two equal forces
B: A single force through the axis / axis کے through single force
C: Two perpendicular velocities / two perpendicular velocities
D: Two equal and opposite parallel forces at different points / different points پر two equal and opposite parallel forces
correct_answer: D | Two equal and opposite parallel forces at different points / different points پر two equal and opposite parallel forces

question: A couple produces:
urdu_translation: couple کیا produce کرتا ہے؟
A: Only translational acceleration / صرف translational acceleration
B: A change in mass / mass میں change
C: Turning effect without a resultant force / resultant force کے بغیر turning effect
D: Zero torque with nonzero force / zero torque with nonzero force
correct_answer: C | Turning effect without a resultant force / resultant force کے بغیر turning effect

question: For a body in rotational equilibrium, the sum of clockwise moments is:
urdu_translation: rotational equilibrium میں clockwise moments کا sum کس کے equal ہوتا ہے؟
B: Mass of the body / body کی mass
D: Sum of anticlockwise moments / anticlockwise moments کے sum
correct_answer: D | Sum of anticlockwise moments / anticlockwise moments کے sum

question: A 30 kg child sits 2 m from a pivot. The opposing moment due to another child must equal:
urdu_translation: 30 kg child pivot سے 2 m دور بیٹھتی ہے۔ opposing moment کس کے equal ہونا چاہیے؟
A: The total mass only / صرف total mass
C: The first child's moment / first child کے moment
correct_answer: C | The first child's moment / first child کے moment

question: A shop balance with unequal arms gives correct results only when:
urdu_translation: unequal arms والی shop balance correct result کب دے گی؟
A: Both pans have zero mass / دونوں pans کی mass zero ہو
B: The turning moments are properly balanced / turning moments properly balanced ہوں
C: The customer uses a spring balance / customer spring balance use کرے
D: The longer arm is ignored / longer arm ignore کیا جائے
correct_answer: B | The turning moments are properly balanced / turning moments properly balanced ہوں

question: A 300 N force acts perpendicularly 1.2 m from a hinge. The torque is:
urdu_translation: 300 N force hinge سے 1.2 m distance پر perpendicularly act کرتی ہے۔ torque معلوم کریں۔

topic: 4.7 Centre of Gravity and Centre of Mass
4.7 Centre of Gravity and Centre of Mass
question: The centre of gravity is the point through which:
urdu_translation: centre of gravity وہ point ہے جس کے through کیا act کرتا ہے؟
A: Only centripetal force acts / صرف centripetal force act کرتی ہے
B: The whole weight of the body is considered to act / body کا whole weight act کرتا considered ہوتا ہے
C: The body has no mass / body کی mass نہیں ہوتی
D: All velocities become zero / تمام velocities zero ہو جاتی ہیں
correct_answer: B | The whole weight of the body is considered to act / body کا whole weight act کرتا considered ہوتا ہے

topic: 4.7 Centre of Gravity and Centre of Mass
question: The centre of mass is the point where:
urdu_translation: centre of mass وہ point ہے جہاں کیا assumed ہوتا ہے؟
A: The whole mass is assumed concentrated / whole mass concentrated assumed ہوتی ہے
B: The whole pressure is zero / whole pressure zero ہوتی ہے
C: Only weight disappears / صرف weight disappear ہوتی ہے
D: The body must rotate / body لازماً rotate کرتی ہے
correct_answer: A | The whole mass is assumed concentrated / whole mass concentrated assumed ہوتی ہے

topic: 4.7 Centre of Gravity and Centre of Mass
question: The centre of mass of a body:
urdu_translation: body کا centre of mass کہاں ہو سکتا ہے؟
A: Always lies inside the body / always body کے inside
B: May lie inside, outside or on the body / body کے inside، outside یا surface پر ہو سکتا ہے
C: Always lies outside the body / always body کے outside
D: Always lies at the lowest point / always lowest point پر
correct_answer: B | May lie inside, outside or on the body / body کے inside، outside یا surface پر ہو سکتا ہے

topic: 4.7 Centre of Gravity and Centre of Mass
question: For an irregular lamina, the centre of gravity can be found experimentally using:
urdu_translation: irregular lamina کا centre of gravity experimentally کس method سے find کیا جا سکتا ہے؟
C: A spring constant graph / spring constant graph
D: Suspension and plumb lines / suspension اور plumb lines
correct_answer: D | Suspension and plumb lines / suspension اور plumb lines

question: A body is in equilibrium when it has:
urdu_translation: body equilibrium میں کب ہوتی ہے؟
B: Maximum torque only / صرف maximum torque
correct_answer: C | No acceleration / no acceleration

question: The first condition of equilibrium is:
urdu_translation: equilibrium کی first condition کیا ہے؟
correct_answer: C | ΣF = 0

question: The second condition of equilibrium is:
urdu_translation: equilibrium کی second condition کیا ہے؟
correct_answer: A | Στ = 0

question: Complete equilibrium requires:
urdu_translation: complete equilibrium کے لیے کیا required ہے؟
A: Only zero resultant force / صرف zero resultant force
B: Only zero resultant torque / صرف zero resultant torque
C: Both resultant force and resultant torque equal zero / resultant force اور resultant torque دونوں zero ہوں
correct_answer: C | Both resultant force and resultant torque equal zero / resultant force اور resultant torque دونوں zero ہوں

question: An accelerated body cannot be in equilibrium because:
urdu_translation: accelerated body equilibrium میں کیوں نہیں ہو سکتی؟
A: Its mass must be zero / اس کی mass zero ہونی چاہیے
B: Its centre of gravity disappears / اس کا centre of gravity disappear ہو جاتا ہے
C: Its resultant force is not zero / اس کی resultant force zero نہیں ہوتی
D: Its torque is always negative / اس کا torque always negative ہوتا ہے
correct_answer: C | Its resultant force is not zero / اس کی resultant force zero نہیں ہوتی

question: A body that returns to its original position after a slight tilt is in:
urdu_translation: slight tilt کے بعد original position پر return کرنے والی body کس equilibrium میں ہے؟
correct_answer: A | Stable equilibrium / stable equilibrium

question: A body that moves farther from its original position after a slight tilt is in:
urdu_translation: slight tilt کے بعد original position سے further move کرنے والی body کس equilibrium میں ہے؟
correct_answer: A | Unstable equilibrium / unstable equilibrium

question: A body that remains in its new position after displacement is in:
urdu_translation: displacement کے بعد new position میں remain کرنے والی body کس equilibrium میں ہے؟
correct_answer: B | Neutral equilibrium / neutral equilibrium

question: Stability is improved by:
urdu_translation: stability کیسے improve کی جاتی ہے؟
A: Raising the centre of gravity and narrowing the base / centre of gravity raise اور base narrow کرکے
B: Increasing speed only / صرف speed increase کرکے
C: Removing all friction / تمام friction remove کرکے
D: Lowering the centre of gravity and widening the base / centre of gravity lower اور base wider کرکے
correct_answer: D | Lowering the centre of gravity and widening the base / centre of gravity lower اور base wider کرکے

question: A racing car is designed low and wide mainly to:
urdu_translation: racing car کو low اور wide mainly کیوں design کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Increase centre of gravity / centre of gravity increase کرنے کے لیے
B: Reduce its mass to zero / اس کی mass zero کرنے کے لیے
C: Increase stability / stability increase کرنے کے لیے
D: Remove centripetal force / centripetal force remove کرنے کے لیے
correct_answer: C | Increase stability / stability increase کرنے کے لیے

question: Centripetal force always acts:
urdu_translation: centripetal force always کس direction میں act کرتی ہے؟
A: Along the tangent away from centre / tangent کے along centre سے away
B: Towards the centre of the circular path / circular path کے centre کی طرف
C: Vertically upward only / صرف vertically upward
D: Opposite to mass / mass کے opposite
correct_answer: B | Towards the centre of the circular path / circular path کے centre کی طرف

question: The expression for centripetal force is:
urdu_translation: centripetal force کا expression کیا ہے؟
correct_answer: D | F = mv²/r

question: For the same mass and speed, centripetal force is greater on a curve with:
urdu_translation: same mass اور speed کے لیے centripetal force کس curve پر greater ہوتی ہے؟
correct_answer: C | Smaller radius / smaller radius

question: In a washing machine spin dryer, water escapes through holes because it:
urdu_translation: washing machine spin dryer میں water holes سے کیوں escape کرتا ہے؟
A: Has no mass / اس کی mass نہیں ہوتی
B: Moves toward the centre permanently / permanently centre کی طرف move کرتا ہے
C: Becomes magnetic / magnetic بن جاتا ہے
D: Does not receive enough centripetal force to follow the drum / drum کو follow کرنے کے لیے enough centripetal force receive نہیں کرتا
correct_answer: D | Does not receive enough centripetal force to follow the drum / drum کو follow کرنے کے لیے enough centripetal force receive نہیں کرتا

question: A cream separator works mainly because heavier and lighter particles require different:
urdu_translation: cream separator mainly کس difference پر work کرتا ہے؟
A: Temperatures at rest / rest پر temperatures
B: Centripetal forces for circular motion / circular motion کے لیے centripetal forces
correct_answer: B | Centripetal forces for circular motion / circular motion کے لیے centripetal forces

question: Moment of force is another name for:
urdu_translation: moment of force کا دوسرا نام کیا ہے؟
correct_answer: A | Torque / torque

question: A cylinder resting on its circular base is normally in:
urdu_translation: circular base پر resting cylinder normally کس equilibrium میں ہوتا ہے؟
correct_answer: C | Stable equilibrium / stable equilibrium

question: The force that keeps an object moving in a circular path is called:
urdu_translation: object کو circular path میں move رکھنے والی force کیا کہلاتی ہے؟
correct_answer: C | Centripetal force / centripetal force
